005package org.wpilib.hardware.discrete;
006
007import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.DIOJNI;
008import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.SimDevice;
009import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryLoggable;
010import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryTable;
011import org.wpilib.util.UsageReporting;
012
013/**
014 * Class to write digital outputs. This class will write digital outputs. Other devices that are
015 * implemented elsewhere will automatically allocate digital inputs and outputs as required.
016 */
017public class DigitalOutput implements AutoCloseable, TelemetryLoggable {
018  private final int m_channel;
019  private int m_handle;
020
021  /**
022   * Create an instance of a digital output. Create an instance of a digital output given a channel.
023   *
024   * @param channel the SmartIO channel to use for the digital output.
025   */
026  public DigitalOutput(int channel) {
027    m_channel = channel;
028
029    m_handle = DIOJNI.initializeDIOPort(channel, false);
030
031    UsageReporting.reportUsage("IO", channel, "DigitalOutput");
032  }
033
034  @Override
035  public void close() {
036    DIOJNI.freeDIOPort(m_handle);
037    m_handle = 0;
038  }
039
040  /**
041   * Set the value of a digital output.
042   *
043   * @param value true is on, off is false
044   */
045  public void set(boolean value) {
046    DIOJNI.setDIO(m_handle, value);
047  }
048
049  /**
050   * Gets the value being output from the Digital Output.
051   *
052   * @return the state of the digital output.
053   */
054  public boolean get() {
055    return DIOJNI.getDIO(m_handle);
056  }
057
058  /**
059   * Get the GPIO channel number that this object represents.
060   *
061   * @return The GPIO channel number.
062   */
063  public int getChannel() {
064    return m_channel;
065  }
066
067  /**
068   * Indicates this input is used by a simulated device.
069   *
070   * @param device simulated device handle
071   */
072  public void setSimDevice(SimDevice device) {
073    DIOJNI.setDIOSimDevice(m_handle, device.getNativeHandle());
074  }
075
076  @Override
077  public void logTo(TelemetryTable table) {
078    table.log("Value", get());
079  }
080
081  @Override
082  public String getTelemetryType() {
083    return "Digital Output";
084  }
085}
